svg.title: K for Kiosk and POS Material Design
svg.desc: A 6.5-second looping animation in which the K from the original key visuals poster becomes a branded kiosk with a sale tag. The sequence introduces kiosk and point-of-sale material design, then shows illustrative kiosk, countertop display and shelf-talker concepts.
svg.metadata: 1920 by 1080; 16:9; 6.5-second loop; the K silhouette and blue, charcoal, cream and red palette are adapted from 11_K_key_visuals.png; no external assets.

g.text: DESIGNED TO ATTRACT. MADE TO ENGAGE.
